items.question: Wouldn't you rather meet in a conference room?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Wouldn't you rather meet in a conference room?”，自然应答是“It would be quieter.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（It would be quieter.）。
